# R5.23 — Assemble all-planned evidence from owning projections

Implements docs/tickets/193_R5.23__population-receipt.md (seq 193
of 246). Requirement ids: **REQ-E-208, REQ-F-003, REQ-F-004,
REQ-F-008, REQ-C-002** (primary targets — achieved engineered D/E
recorded; the full-target predicates stay owed to their named
later owners per the coverage register), **REQ-A-101**
(contributing only — never duplicate ownership).

## Summary

Lands `population-receipt/1` — the §6.1 all-planned closure
reconcile inside `hh-analysis` (Packet C / PADR-R5-3∗ C.9 checks
2/6; admitted GATE-G9): the six-hop set-equality chain
`slots→plans→first/all attempts→settlements/selected
grades→rows→analysis` derived from the pinned owner views, with
four separate per-slot verdict axes (prerequisite/invocation/
task/veto) and the closed fourteen-code failure set. A reconcile
mismatch is a recorded finding — `verdict: failed` with typed
`ReceiptFailure`s — never a thrown error and never a smaller
denominator.

## What changed

- `crates/hh-analysis/src/receipt.rs` (new) — one public entry,
  `assemble_receipt(&ExperimentView, &[EvalRun], &[TaskContext],
  metric_ref, pins, &DeclaredReceipt) →
  Result<PopulationReceipt, AnalysisError>`:
  - **Expected side derived, never declared** — the landed R5.15
    contract fold via the 184a `population::planned_population`
    adapter does member resolution + the three named populations
    (X7 — never a second rule); `PlanState.attempts` +
    `launch_binding` fold into the same `run_id → plan_ref`
    binding the contract uses; `PopulationError` refusals
    propagate verbatim through `AnalysisError::Population`.
  - **Declared side records-in** — `DeclaredReceipt` carries the
    frozen slot set, per-plan attempt sets, settlement `{run,
    settlement_ref, cost_version}`, grade `{run, grade_ref,
    selection_ref, ordinal, counts_subject, status}`, row `{run,
    version_id, plan_ref}` and the analysis declaration
    `{protocol_ref, prices, method, seed, draws, weights, …}`;
    no crate edge added to hh-bundle (C.1 item 6 / C.10).
  - **Six reconcile legs** — each reports expected/joined/
    failures: `slots_to_plans` (`dropped_slot`/`extra_slot` —
    not-run/refused/pending members stay required),
    `plans_to_attempts` (`orphan_launch`/`dropped_attempt`),
    `attempts_to_settlements` (`missing_settlement`/
    `duplicate_record`/`stale_cost_version`),
    `attempts_to_grades` (`duplicate_grade`/`grade_retry_adds_n`
    — I-03/`grade_status_violation`/`stale_selection`),
    `attempts_to_rows` (`missing_row`/`duplicate_record`/
    `wrong_member_join`; bound-not-run is a typed `not_run`
    loss), `rows_to_analysis` (`missing_analysis_pin` — pins bind
    exactly or not at all).
  - **Four-axis per-slot verdicts** — `SlotVerdicts` records
    `member`/`recovered`/`all_attempts` plus
    prerequisite {available, unavailable, unknown}, invocation
    {not_run, started, finished, unknown}, task {pass, fail,
    refused, unsupported, skipped, unknown}, veto {none,
    observed(+ids), unknown} — a finished invocation never erases
    a skipped/format failure and never writes the task axis.
  - **`population-receipt/1` canonical record** — `{schema,
    version, pins, legs[], slots[], analysis, population,
    verdict, failures[]}` over `hh_wire::Json`; `verdict` ∈
    `closed | failed`; `EVIDENCE_CLASS` fixed `derived_index` —
    a hash match or a finished process axis never promotes it.
- `crates/hh-analysis/src/lib.rs` — `pub mod receipt` +
  re-exports (+6 lines).
- `crates/hh-analysis/tests/r5_23.rs` — 9-check AC battery
  (compile-red at base `d5f6810a`).
- ADR-0401 (landing record); coverage dated contributing note;
  BL-47 append + regenerated ADR index/revisit triggers.

## Design decisions (ADR-0401)

The receipt is one in-process owner interface — the
`population-receipt/1` record is the legs'+verdicts' own fold
(decomposition row 31 names "R5.23 assembly" one owner; the
L150 contract-vs-consumer seam is consumed — this ticket is the
consumer side of the landed R5.15/184a pair). Mismatches are
recorded findings — the receipt retains deviations (§6.1)
instead of making producer keep/drop decisions in extras; the
analysis pins bind exactly (`missing_analysis_pin`), never
re-derived into a second authority.
